Nlonu maləka n mi ɓəə gye wo n gnyiagnyi tu n shikwo ɓədo n əknyii nyi, wa la əwo ɓwaizhe ɓwa wu n əshemi.
Njesnu wa si nyasi n woi, n wo n wyewyeyi lo nyalonyalo nya nyi, əza n wo ɓə zhni ashemi n anyai vnyanya n ɓa fyi n ɓa nyi, əknyi ɓədo n anyai vnyanya n ɓa fyi n kwo, n shikwoi n anyai vnyanya n ɓa fyi n kwo, jesnu wa gna, “Əsa gyi to shnasnu lo m!
Ama fyi n anyipyei yi, əsa n maləka tnaaba yi ɓə ye wa bye əwo mwayi yaakwo ncei, aɓo sosoi Shekwoyi nya ɓə kwu nu, n ɓwasnu she wo ɓə dnawyi ga sheaɓəgwognayi əwo atnutnuyi nyi.”
Nlonu bəgye n mi ɓəə kwu wo kwoi daɓo n mii n əshemi nyi, kwa je əɓo da n mii njesnu: “Lo, ho gwo əpakpmikpmii n kwo shi n kpekpeiya n maləka akwnu n wo gnyiagnyi tu n shikwo n əknyii nyi.”
Nlonu ma lo da maləkai ma gna wo nge wo ga mi əpakpmikpmii ɓyii. Wa gna mi, “Gwo kwo ha gyi kwo. Kwo ɓa pmyi ho nubwo dna n mamái, ama fyi n əho əgbe ho ɓa wo kwo n dadai ngye əsugbma nu.”
Ma gwo əpakpmikpmii ɓyii n maləka akwnu ma gyi kwo. Kwo ɓə da ngye əsugbma nu fyi n əmi əgbe, ama she mi ɓə gyi kwo, əmi nubwo kwa pmyi dna n mamái.
Nlonu a gna mi, “Ɓəshishi nu ha je sheɓəgwognada ntu aza bəgyé ɓo, n aknyii, n abyei jesnu n asui.”

A ɓə la nuwnaje ga mi ngye abamwi-bwusi jesnu a gna mi, “Lo ho mwi bəgədi Dagayipwuwa Shekwoyi nya ɓədo n əkwo amwamwagayii.
“Ama la akpeda əbmyi nya knaya; to mwu kwo m, ntuge a lá kwo ga Abyedo. Ɓa ɓə kpe əzhiyaakwo gyigyiyi apita apya shiinyi-ceaba nu.
“Njesnu mi ɓə knyí əmi aɓəgbmiyi ngwnu-aba, ɓa ɓə da sheɓəgwogna anyipyei dugwu gbmanyi n tagyi-abacei-shiitnanyi (1,260) n ajekwokwoi kpe.”
Əɓa nu zhni zaitu “ashnuwnagnayi ngwnu-aba” n apyitila-kwnuyii ngwnu-aba, jesnu “ɓa gnyiagnyi zhi n Dagayi əknyi nya abye nu.”
Zahozahoyi n wa zhniatna ge wa wu ɓa, əná kwa kwnu n əɓa agbe kwa gyi əɓa anuwnuyi. Zokwo nu nyi n zahozahoyi n wo ɓa ye wa zhni ɓa əkpí, ɓəshishi nu wa fyí nlai.
Ɓa n kalái lo ɓa gwu ashebmana nabai to ogbma kwa zhi dna n əsa n ɓa zhi ɓai da ɓəwyegye nyi m; jesnu ɓa n kalái lo ɓa pmyi nuwna bma kwaa zè ami jesnu ɓa ɓe əknyi n agwnù dəhodəhoi pyai n əsahosahoi n ɓa ncei pma.
Əsa n ɓa ɓə pwo n əɓa ɓəgbmi, nyawnanyawna n kwo gbmiɓe n ɓwokwnu loloyi nyi, kwo ɓə snukwnú n ɓai, jesnu kwoi gyi ɓa əsnu, kwoi kwu ɓa wu.
Əɓa anayi ɓə kwu zhi n aduba ayaakwo əzhiyaakwo nya, n a yi kwo n ɓədazeshii nge Sodom ɓədo n Masar nyi, aba ń a ɓə tu əɓa Dagayi n znudu nyi.
A ɓwa anyipyei ngwnu-ata n tokwnui, azahozahoyi ɓai kwnu n əbyé, nyitala ɓədo n əknyii ɓa kwu zhi ɓai shi əɓa anayi awye jesnu to ɓa ye nge a byi ɓa m.
Aza n ɓa fyi n əknyi nyi, ɓa ɓə ma ɓa asna jesnu ɓai nya agbmada ɓai tnu aje n anyaga agbmada nyai, ntuge sheaɓəgwognayi ye ngwnu-aba ɓa kwu azhnìgye wu aza n ɓa fyi n əknyi nyi.
Ama n anyipyei ngwnu-ata n tokwnuyi avnu, əsnu wyewyeyi nya kwoi kwnu n Shekwoyi aba kwa kwu lofyi ɓa, jesnu ɓa kwukazhi n agnyi, aza n ɓa ɓə gye ɓa nyi, ɓa kwu fyifyiya zhi n ədnai.
Nlonu ɓa wo bəgye kaláda kwoi gbmi n əshemi kwoi gna ɓa, “Fye gwnuzhi ɓe ń ya.” Nlonu ɓa gwnulo əshemi fyi n ənyìi, əsa n əɓa anuwnuyi ɓə zhi ɓai shiawye.
Nsayii əknyi ashnaje yaakwo kwa jeashna jesnu okwu gbmanyi n akwu ngwnu-awo əzhiyaakwo yi nya kwaa laya. Aza adugwu tnaaba ɓa kwu fyí fyi n əknyi ashnaje yi, aza n ɓa ɓə cezhi n wyewyeyi nyi, ədna kwa wo ɓa jesnu ɓa ga Shekwoyi mwamwa n wo dna n əshemi nyi.
Owii baayi kwo la duya; owii taayi ɓe lo wolowolo.
Maləka tnaaba yi wa bye əwo mwayi, jesnu a wo abəgye awyiɓeyi latui fyi n əshemi n ɓa ɓə gna:
“Əbemi anyì nya kwo la zè
əyi Dagayi nya ɓədo n əwo Kirisitii,
jesnu wo ɓə gyibe nyalonyalo.”
Nlonu azakwoyi shiiba-ceanyi, n ɓa ɓə sase kpe n abeshnikpegye n Shekwoyi abye nyi, ɓa yazhi ɓa ga Shekwoyi mwamwa,
ɓai gna:
“Yi sa ho ami lo, Dagayi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya,
Əza n wo nyi, jesnu n wo ɓəi nyi,
ntuge ho la əho kalá yaakwo gwo,
jesnu ho la ya hoi gyibe.
Abye ɓə kwu minagyi gyi,
əho minagyi napyei kwo la ɓe.
Əsa la si a da afyífyiyi owa,
jesnu a ga əho atnutnuyi sheaɓəgwognayi gyiba ɓədo
n azai n ɓa ga əho əye mwamwa n ɓa wo əho əye ədna,
aza ayaakwo ɓədo n anawyii,
ntuge ho ɓa zhni aza yi agbma n ɓa ɓə zhni əknyi agbma nyi.”
Nlonu dagayipwuwa Shekwoyi nya dna n əshemi kwaa gwuya gnyi, jesnu dna n əwo dagayipwuwa yi a gye akwati Shekwoyi ɓəgbeshi nya əwye. Njesnu ogbmana kwa bmyana, kwoi sáwyi, kwoi jeawyi kwoi gwoya, əknyi ashnaje ɓədo n ogbmashni yaakwoi.

Əznù yaakwo kwa kpeyawu dna n əshemi: nyikwoza n ajei kpe ngye nyipyei, n əpyai dna n əwo apitabwada snuta jesnu n fnunyi akpasi awoceaba nyai kwnu n əwo tukwo.
Wo ɓə gnyi n nubwoi nu jesnu wa ci ɓyimanyasna əɓwi, əsa n wo ɓə ye wa kágna ncei.
Nlonu əznù ədo kwa kpeyawu dna n əshemi: tumise byei yaakwo gwnugwnùi n atukwoi gyi ngwnu-tnaaba, ɓədo n amwayii ngwnu-awo jesnu n afnunyi kwnu ngwnu-tnaaba n əkwo atukwo.
Əkwo sesi kwa kpma akpasi okwu gbmanyi ya n akwu ngwnu-ata n əshebmana, kwa sheɓaya zhi n əknyi. Tumise yi kwaa gnyiagnyi gnyi n nyikwoza yi abye n wo ɓə ye wa kágna nyi, nabai n kwo ɓə gyi əɓyi əsa n a ma wo ncei.
Wa ma nugwnu, əɓyinugbai, n wo “ɓəi gyibe tu n aknyi vnyanya n snukna bwusii.” Njesnu a la əwo əɓyi gwnulo ncei n Shekwoyi aba jesnu lo ncei n əwo əbeshnikpegye.
Nyikwo yi wa bwusi lo zhabwikawu, lo aba n Shekwoyi ɓə ncei zhniaba gnyi wo, aba ń a ɓə vyi wo ɓo jesnu a wna wo akna anyipyei dugwu gbmanyi cei-atagyi aba cei-shiitnanyi (1,260).
Nlonu okwnu kwa ya n əshemi. Mikailu n əwo amaləkai ɓa snukwnú n tumisei, jesnu tumise n əkwo amaləkai ɓa snukwnú ce.
Ama wo to ɓə n akalái fyi n kwnuce m, jesnu ɓa kwu ɓwu əɓa afyiba nuwna n əshemi.
A she tumise yaakwo gwnugwnùi yi yazhi n əknyi, owa saapa nya, ń a yi kwo zanukwoi, kwo Shetam, n wo dna anyì vnyanya ń abaɓwi nyi. A shewoya shi n əknyi, ɓədo n əwo amaləkai.
Nlonu ma wo bəgye kaláda dna n əshemi kwoi gna:
“Nsaiye gnyignyi kwo la ɓe ɓədo n kalái
jesnu n əyi Shekwoyi əbemii,
ɓədo n ikwoi əwo Masifu nyai.
Ntuge aɓəmayi tu n azaje n əyi amapwii,
n wo kpe ɓa aɓo gnyi n əyi Shekwoyi abye n nyipyeii ɓədo n sukwoi nyi,
a la wo sheyashi n əknyi.
Ɓa kwu nasalagyi kpe n əwo tukwo
n Kwugyasnáyi amii
jesnu n əɓa ɓədagbma ɓəgbmi nyai;
ɓa to ɓə ye əɓa awyewyeyi dəidəi
n ɓa ɓəə ɓa wo əfyí ədna m.
Ntucenu, fye nya agbmada, əfye ashebmana
ɓədo n fyei n fye fyi n ɓa nyi!
Ama owii n əknyii ɓədo n shikwoi,
ntuge əzanukwoyi wo la gbmi shnizhi da fye!
Wo nunui lo n minagyi nazhii,
ntuge wo kpəlo nge əsa to ye n woi celo n kwnu m.”
She tumise ɓə gye a lá kwo sheyashi n əknyi, wa nya nyikwoyi n əsii, n wo ɓə ma əɓyinugbai nyi.
A kwu aɓwase ngwnu-aba znukwo nya ga nyikwoza yi, nabai n wo ɓa myi wa gyeafu lo aba ń a cei zhni gnyi wo n zhabwikawu, aba ń a ɓa wna wo akna kwaa la əsa, asa ɓədo n əsa tokwnuyii, aba n owa yi taa myi kwa si m.
Nlonu owa kwa she nuwna ya n əkwo əgbe ngye əlà, ntuge kwaa nyikwoza yi znuakpe jesnu kwa wna wo n nuwna ɓeɓeyii.
Ama əknyi kwa bma nyikwoza yi zhni kwa là əkwo əgbe ya kwa myi əlà ń tumise ɓə sheya n əkwo əgbe nyi.
Nlonu tumise kwa gyi minagyi nazhii n nyikwoza yii, kwa jezelo kwoo snukwnú n nyikwoyi aɓyii, aza yi n ɓa vyi Shekwoyi ɓəgbetu jesnu n ɓa shi əɓa ɓəgbmi əɓwa dəidəi ntu n Yeisu ɓo nyi.

Tumise kwaa kwnukpe n shikwo əgbe. Jesnu ma gye nyawnanyawna kwoi kwnuɓe n shikwo. Kwo ɓə n amwayii gyi ngwnu-awo n atukwoi gyi ngwnu-tnaaba, n afnunyii kwnu n əkwo amwayi, jesnu tu n tukwo dəhodəhoi, kwo ɓə n əye atukwopmi ɓədai ka tu.
Nyawnanyawna n mi ɓə gye nyi, kwo ɓə gbe nakpmi, ama kwo ɓə n apitai wu ngye nyafwanya n a yi ge byiya, jesnu n əgbei wu ngye gaba. Tumise kwa ga nyawnanyawna əkwo kalá yaakwo əbeshnikpegye nya.
Nyawnanyawna yi əkwo tukwo gbmanyi, ɓə wu ngye kwo ɓə lá əci yaakwo ɓwa, ama əci yaakwo yi ɓəə la ɓyi. Anyì vnyanya ɓə nunui gnyi n ɓəwowoi jesnu ɓa vyi nyawnanyawna yi.
Aza ɓa ga tumise yi mwamwa, ntuge wo ɓə lá ikwo ga nyawnanyawna yi, jesnu ɓa ga nyawnanyawna yi mwamwa ce, ɓa nyaɓo, “Nyika nu lo ngye nyawnanyawna ye a? Nyika nu ɓa myi wa snukwnú n əkwoi a?”
A ɓə la əgbe ga nyawnanyawna wa da tukwomwa aɓədagbma n atukwopmi nyai, jesnu wa wu əwo ikwo apya ngwnu-shinyiceaba.
Kwa kpe əkwo əgbe ya nabai kwa da atukwopmi ɓəda kpe Shekwoyi jesnu kwa wnu əwo əye ya n əwo asesebai ɓədo n aza yii n ɓa fyi n əshemi nyi.
A ɓə la kalá ga kwo nabai kwa snukwnú n Shekwoyi aza gyigyiyii jesnu kwa gyi nasala tu n ɓa. Njesnu a ɓə la ikwo ga kwo tu n əbyé dəhodəhoi, ń azai, n anyitalai, n əknyii.
Aza vnyanya n ɓa fyilo n anyì nyi, ɓa ɓə ga nyawnanyawna yi mwamwa; aza yi vnyanya n a to n əɓa ayei kafyilo n Kwugyasnáyi pafyi wyewyeyi nya m, Kwugyasnáyi n a ɓə la wo znusha tunyi n anyì zhnizhni əsa.
Zahozahoyi n wo n atnubwai lo, akpəge wo wo.
Ngye əzaho lo n a ɓa wna lo ncei n əknyido nu,
əknyii nu n a ɓa wna wo lo ncei.
Ngye əzaho lo n a ɓa wu wo n əbeyaakwoi nu,
əbeyaakwo nu ɓa wu wo.
Dəye wu ge Shekwoyi aza ɓa ɓwa bwugba əmìfyi nya jesnu n gaiciyanunui.
Nlonu ma gye nyawnanyawna baayi kwoi gbmiɓe n əknyi. Kwo ɓə n amwayii gyi ngwnu-aba ngye Kwugyasnáyi, ama kwa daɓo ngye tumise.
Kwo ɓə kwu ikwo vnyanya nyawnanyawna kpmisnui nya pya wu n əkwo apitaɓwi, jesnu kwa zhni aza vnyanya fyi n anyì, ɓa ga nyawnanyawna kpmisnui mwamwa, ń əkwo əci yaakwo ɓə la ɓyi nyi.
Nlonu kwa kwu aznù ayaakwo wu, kwaa si kwoi yi əná kwoi kaya shnizhi n əshemi zhi n əknyi n aza awye pəipəi.
Ntu n aznù ɓo n a ɓə ga kwo ikwo ge kwo zhni n nyawnanyawna kpmisnui apitaɓwi nyi, kwa kwu aza n ɓa fyi n anyì nyi dnakwoce. Kwa ga ɓa əgbe nge ɓa la ənyadogbe shignyi ntu nyawnanyawna ɓo n a ɓə tu kwo əci n əbeyaakwoi, kwaa dudu kwaa gnyi n wyewyeyi nyi.
A ɓə la kalá ga nyawnanyawna baayi kwa ga nyawnanyawna kpmisnui nyadogbe əsnu, nabai n nyadogbe yi ɓa myi kwa daɓo, jesnu kwa zhni aza vnyanya n ɓa to ɓə ye ɓa ga nyadogbe mwamwa nyi m, a kwu ɓa wu.
Njesnu kwaa kwo zhni ɓəshishi nu, n aza vnyanya aba; əza yaakwo n anawyii, gyiwyeda n əsnayii, loloiya n fyenuyi, ɓa gwo atuzè n əɓa əɓwa ɓwaizhe nya, kwo n nyikwnumi,
nabai n zahozahoyi taa myi wa si ənya kwo wa kwnu ənya m, akpəge wo n atuzèi tu lo, n kwo nu zhni əye nyawnanyawnai nya kwo nyadokwu əwo əye nya nyi.
Dəye wu ge a la wyemwa ɓwa. Akpəge əza n wo n awyegai lo, wa kwu nyawnanyawna namba aje, ntuge kwo zhni zanyikwoci namba nu. Namba yi nu nyi, atagyi-tnanyi-cei-shiitnanyi-ceitnanyi (666).

Nlonu ma shiawye, ma gye Kwugyasnáyi gnyi n əmi abye, n gnyiagnyi tu n Siyona Əpe, aza adugwu tagyi cei-shiinyi-ceanyi (144,000) ɓə kwnusnu n woi, n ɓa ɓə n əwo əye ɓədo n əwo Dada nyai kakpe n əɓa anyikwnumi.
Jesnu ma wo kəsnu n əshemi ngye nuwna ɓeɓeyi aɓoci, jesnu ngye əgbmawyije yaakwo. Aɓoci n mi ɓə wo nyi kwo ɓə wo ngye amwulo snáyi nu ɓə zhi ɓai agyi amwulo.
Njesnu ɓa kwoanyi woiwoyi zhi n əbeshnikpegye abye jesnu zhi n anyawyewyeyi ngwnu-anyi abye ɓədo n azakwoyii. Zahozahoyi to ɓə myi wa tu anyí ye mwi m akpəge aza 144,000 ye n ɓa kwu shnashna ɓwa ń anyì nyi.
Aza yi nu nyi n ɓa to ɓə kpe əɓahni cegye n anyikwozai m, ntuge ɓa ɓə kwu myizhi n kwului. Ɓa vyi Kwugyasnáyi abahobahoi n wa lo. A ɓə si ɓa fyi n azanyikwoci atasni nu jesnu ɓa kwu ɓa ga ngye anya-gyigyiyi kpmisnui n Shekwoyi aba ɓədo n Kwugyasnáyi.
A to ɓəə wna ɓa n akatai m. Ɓa zhni a tnaɓəkpeyi aza nu.
Nlonu ma gye maləka do woi gyeafu tu lo n anyìbmana atasni, jesnu wo ɓə n nabagyi manai nyalonyalo nyai shi nabai wa da aza n ɓa fyi n anyì nyi; ga əknyi dəhodəhoi, əbyé, nyitala ɓədo n azai.
Wa daɓo n bəgyei latu, “Fye wo Shekwoyi ədna jesnu fya la wo tu, ntuge əsa n wo ɓa da owa nyi kwo la si. Ga əza mwamwa n wo ɓə zhni ashemi, anyì, shikwo ɓədo n anuwna-pyipyii nyi.”
Maləka baayi wa vyi ɓe jesnu wa gna, “ ‘Kwo la myiya! Kwo la myiya! Babyila Yaakwo kwo la myiya,’ əkwo nu ɓə zhni aknyi vnyanya ɓa sni əkwo əje nyacei anagbáizhni nya.”
Maləka taayi wa vyi ɓa ɓe jesnu wa daɓo n bəgyei latui: “Zahozahoyi n wa ga nyawnanyawna mwamwa ɓədo n ənya-jiji əwo dogbe nyai, jesnu wa gwo əznù n əwo nyikwnumi kwo n əwo əɓwa,
əwohni ce, wo ɓə sni əje Shekwoyi minagyi nazhii nya, n a la zeya fyi n nunui n əbwe əwo minagyi napyei nya. A ɓə tu wo n zhowozhowoi n solufo nagyii n amaləka agyigyiyi awyeba, ɓədo n Kwugyasnáyi.
Njesnu awú əɓa zhowozhowo nya ɓə kwuka gwnulo nyalonyalo. Snusnu to lo n nyipyeii kwo n sukwoi, ntu aza yi ɓo n ɓa ɓə ga nyawnanyawna mwamwa ɓədo n ənya-jiji əwo dogbe nyai nyi m, kwo ntu əzahozahoyi ɓo n wo ɓə la atuzè əwo əye nya gwo m.”
Dəye wu ge Shekwoyi aza ɓa ɓwa bwugba əmìfyi nya; əɓa n ɓa n Shekwoyi ɓəda ɓəgbetui shiɓwa, jesnu n myizhi n gaiciyaganunui dna n Yeisu.
Nlonu ma wo bəgye kwoi gbmi n əshemi kwa gna, “Kanya ye: Anabəlikada nu n azafyifyiyi n ɓa fyí fyi n Dagayi, ənya n kwo laka nsaiye kwoi lo n abye nyi.” Zafnu da lo, “Əə, ɓa ɓə kwu snu ń əɓa atnutnu, ntuge əɓa atnutnu ɓəə vyi ɓa.”
Mi ɓə shiawye, ma gye ənyìi bwuibwui n gnyi n əmi abye, jesnu əza n wo ɓə sasetu n ənyìi nyi, wo ɓə wu ngye əza nugwnu nu n fnunyi zinali nyai kwnu n əwo tukwo n lumizhegye gyigyíi shi n əwo akwnu.
Nlonu maləka do wa gbmiɓe n Dagayipwuwa, wa yì əza n wo ɓə sasetu n ənyìi nyi, “La əho lumizhegye ha gbe, ntuge əsa nyagbe nya kwo la si, ntuge anyì dòdò əsa kwo la si.”
Ntulonu əza n wo ɓə sasetu n ənyìi nyi, wa dna əwo lumizhegye n anyì, waa anyì dò.
Maləka ədo wa gbmiɓe n Dagayipwuwa, n əshemi, əwohni ce ɓə n lumizhegye gyigyíi shi.
Dudulonu maləka, n əná ɓə fyi n əwo akwnu nu nyi, wa gbmiɓe n bəgədi wa yì əza n bəgyei latu n wo ɓə n lumizhegye gyigyíi shi nyi, “La əho lumizhegye gyigyíi, ha ye anam gyigyi agada zhi n anyì ha ɓe ncei, ntuge əkwo agyigyi kwu ɓyi.”
Maləka wa du əwo lumizhegye dna n anyì, wa ye əkwo agyigyii zhi jesnu wa sheɓaya fyi n Shekwoyi anamnuwnapyiba yaakwo əwo minagyi napyei nya.
A dna jemwunyi byei fyi n anamnuwnapyiba n kwo gbmiya gnyi n əzhiyaakwo nyi, jesnu ami ɓa zhè n əgbmapyi aba, ń lawu n asná ngye dokwo aluzhamyi asná, n əkpaai ngye Kyilomita 300.

Ma gye əznù ədo ɓəwowoi yaakwo nya, dna n əshemi: amaləka ngwnu-tnaaba n agwnù akpmasnui shi, ngwnu-tnaaba. Əɓa nu ɓə zhni akpmaknai ntuge n əɓai nu n Shekwoyi minagyi napyei ɓə nu.
Jesnu ma gye ənya n kwo ɓə wu ngye shikwo maganyi kwoi bmyana n gbmaje n ənái. Njesnu n azai gnyiagnyi kpe n shikwogbe, n ɓa ɓə kwu nasalagyi tu n nyawnanyawna n əkwo nyadogbei, n namba əkwo əye nyai. Ɓa kwu amwulo shi n Shekwoyi ɓə ga ɓa nyi
ɓa kwoanyi Mwusa nya, Shekwoyi tnutnuyi jesnu n Kwugyasnáyi nyai:
“Aɓo ayaakwo n aɓoawowoyii ɓa zhni əho atnutnu nu,
Dagayi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya.
Əho azokwo zhni afyecei nu n gaiciyai,
Əsu abye nya.
Dagayi, nyika nu taa wo ho ədna ma a,
jesnu wa ɓe n latui ga əho əye ma a?
Ntuge əho nu ɓwasnu gbmanyi kəto n ho gyigyiyi.
Abye vnyanya ɓa ɓə ɓe
ɓa ga mwamwa zhi n əho abye,
ntuge a la əho atnutnu aɓəfyece nya kpmiyawu.”
N dəye avnu, ma shiawye ma gye dagayipwuwa dna n əshemi; n əkwo nu zhni dagayilubwui owa ɓəgbeshi nya nyi; kwo ɓə gwugwuiya gnyi.
Amaləka ngwnu-tnaaba ɓa kwnuɓe n Dagayipwuwa, n agwnù ngwnu-tnaabai shi. Ɓa ɓə n aje agyigyiyii aluweluwei anashei kpe jesnu n azinali ajeɓyii wna n əɓa agwu.
Nlonu nyawyewyeyi gbmanyi fyi n ngwnu-anyi yi, kwa ga amaləka ngwnu-tnaaba ashnapa ngwnu-tnaaba azinali nya, n nunui n Shekwoyi minagyi napyei n wo nyì nyalonyalo nyi.
Njesnu Dagayipwuwa kwaa nu gnyi n awúi n ɓa kwnu n Shekwoyi latu aba ɓai kwnu n əwo kalái. Zahozahoyi to ɓə myi wa lodna n Dagayipwuwa m, nya əsa n agwnù ngwnu-tnaaba, amaləka ngwnu-tnaaba nya ɓə kwu tnutnu zozhni.

Nlonu ma wo bəgye n latu kwoi gbmi n Dagayipwuwa kwoi gna amaləka ngwnu-tnaaba yi, “Fye lo, fye zè ashnapa ngwnu-tnaaba Shekwoyi minagyi napyei nya ya kpe n əknyi.”
Maləka kpmisnui wa lo wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n əknyi, jesnu aci asnasnai ɓa kwnukpe n aza n ɓa ɓə n əznù nyawnanyawna nyai kpe jesnu ɓai ga əkwo dogbe mwamwa.
Maləka baayi wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n shikwo, kwa kwu zè ngye zafyi ami, jesnu ənya wyewyeyi dəhodəhoi n kwo ɓə dna n shikwonyi kwo ɓə la fyí.
Maləka taayi wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n àlà ɓədo n anyaɓwo-nuwnai, jesnu ɓa kwu zè ami.
Nlonu ma wo maləka n anuwna ɓə fyi n əwo akwnu nyi woi gna:
“Ho kwu awa ye da ceewo, O Əza Gyigyiyi,
əho n ho nyì jesnu n ho ɓəə nyì nyi;
ntuge ɓa la əho aza gyigyiyi ami zeya ǹ sheaɓəgwognayi anyai,
jesnu ho kwu ami ga ɓa nge ɓa sni ngye shi kwo gwo a zhni ɓa.”
Ma wo bəgədi kwoi dnaɓəgbe:
“Əə, Dagayi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya,
əho awada zhni gaiciya nu jesnu n wu ceewo.”
Maləka nyiiyi wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n nyipyei, jesnu aa nyipyei fa kwa gyi aza əná n əkwo ənái.
Ɓa ɓə la tokpe ntu nyipyei ənagyi ɓo, jesnu ɓa kpe Shekwoyi əye aknyi, n əwo nu ɓə ikwoi ntu n agwnù yi nyi, dudulonu to ɓa yeabwi m, jesnu to ɓa ga wo mwamwa m.
Maləka tnuuyi wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n nyawnanyawna əbeshnikpegye, jesnu əkwo əbemi kwaa nu gnyi n wyegbmai. Aza ɓa gyi əɓa anyitala fyi n snasna yaakwo
jesnu ɓa kpe Shekwoyi əshemi nya aknyi ntu n əɓa aci snasna ɓo, ama ɓaa abwiye aɓo na n aɓo n ɓa ɓəə kwu zhni nyi.
Maləka tnaanyii wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya kpe n Ifyiretus əlà yaakwo, jesnu əkwo nuwna kwa kwu woakawu nabai wa zhni zokwo ntu asu ɓo n ɓa kwnu n Kpəkwó ɓwa nyi.
Nlonu ma gye ase ajegbmii ngwnu-ata n wu ngye adugba; ɓa kwnuɓe n tumise əgbe, n nyawnanyawna əgbei njesnu n sheɓəgwognayi katái əgbei.
Ɓa nu zhni ase n ɓa zhni aznù, n ɓa kwnuya lo da asu ń anyìmi vnyanya, ɓa ye ɓa zhi ntu okwnusnu ɓo n nyipyei yaakwoi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya nya.
“Shiawye, mi ɓe lo ngye əvyì! Anabəlikada nu n əzai n wa pmi mi, jesnu waa myignyi, n əwo ajei kpe, nabai n wo to ɓə lo n ɓwotoloyii m, jesnu ai pmi wo ya gnyi n vnyinkwoi m.”
Nlonu ɓa ye asu zhi ń abagbmanyi n aba n Aibraniyi yi nge Amagədon nyi.
Maləka tnaabai wa zè əwo shnapa anya ya fyi n əse, a wo bəgye latui kwoi gbmiɓe n Dagayipwuwa kwoi gbmi n əbeshnikpegye, kwoi gna, “A kwu zozhni!”
Nlonu ogbmana kwa bmya laɓa, kwoi sáwyi, ogbma awyijei kwoi gwoawyiya, jesnu əknyi kwa jeashna ɓwoye kwoi sofyi. Əknyi ashnaje ye pya to ɓəə shnizhni m kpeekpe shi a ɓəi zhni zanyikwoci dna n anyì m, əknyi ashnaje ye ɓə wodna.
Əzhiyaakwo Babyila kwa gnajeya akwu ngwnu-ata, azhi ayaakwo abye nya ɓaa myiya. Shekwoyi wa pá Babyila Yaakwo ɓo jesnu wa ga kwo bwoɓyi n nunui n anamnuwnai əwo minagyi nazhii nya.
Mwuse dəhodəhoi kwa bwusiya laɓa jesnu to a gye ape dəhodəhoi əwye m.
N anyìbmana, a gye agbmakwuta adnagbmai, dəhodəhoi n woshna ngye Kyilo shiitnu, ɓa kaya kpe n aza. Njesnu ɓa kpe Shekwoyi aknyi ntu ogwnù agbmakwuta nya ɓo, ntuge ogwnù ye ɓə wodna wowoi zam.

Maləka gbmanyi n əɓa ngwnu-tnaaba n ɓa ɓə n ashnapa tnaabai shi nyi, wa ɓe wa gna mi, “Ɓe, ma wu ho tata, kaluwa yaakwo nya, n wo sase ma n anuwna bəgyé nyi.
“N nyikwo yei nu n asu ń ɓa fyi n əknyi nyi ɓəə zhni anagbái, jesnu azanyikwoci n ɓa ɓə fyi n əknyi nyi, ɓa ɓə jejei zhi zam ntu anamnuwna əwo anagbáizhni nya n ɓa sni nyi.”
Nlonu maləka wa la mi lo ncei dna n Zafnu lo zhabwikawu. N abaayi ma gye nyikwoza n sasetu n nyawnanyawna byeibyei n kwo ɓə shi n pwuanya shi n atukwopmi ɓədai jesnu n atukwoi gyi ngwnu-tnaaba n amwayii gyi ngwnu-awo.
Nyikwoza yi ɓə n aje bmyinabmyinai nu kpe ɓədo n byeibyei, jesnu kwoi bmyana n zinalii, akwuta anakwoi ɓədo n anya amanaii. Wo ɓə n bwoɓyi zinali nyai shi n əwo akwnu, n nunui n asisiɓoi ɓədo n anya nukwoi əwo anagbáizhni nya.
Əye n kwo ɓə ka tu ń əwo nyikwnumi nyi kwo ɓə zhni asigyi nu:
Babyila Yaakwo
Akaluwa Əya
Ɓədo n Asisiɓoi n Əknyi.
Mi ɓə gye nyikwo ye n fyije nu shi, n Shekwoyi aza gyigyiyi amii, aza yi ami, n ɓa ɓə gbmi Yeisu əɓo nyi. She mi ɓə gye nyikwo ye, kwaa mi zè ɓəwowo n mwa zam.
Nlonu maləka wa gna mi: “Knyiyi nu zhni cei wo ho a? Mi ɓa ga ho awyega asigyi əɓo, nyikwo ye nya, ɓədo n nyawnanyawnai n wo gwnu kwo nyi, n kwo n atukwoi gyi ngwnu-tnaaba n amwayii gyi ngwnu-awo nyi.
Nyawnanyawna n ha gye kwo nyi, kwo ɓə nyi, ama nsaiye kwo to ye lo m, jesnu kwo ɓə gbmi gwnuzhi n ɓwokwnu loloyi nu, kwoi lo əkwo agbmazhniba. Aza n ɓa fyilo n əknyi n a to n əɓa ayei kafyilo n pafyi wyewyeyi nya, ənya n kwo ɓə laka n anyizhni əsa m, ce ɓo wo ɓa əsa n ɓa ɓə gye nyawnanyawna əwye, ntuge əsa lo n kwo ɓəə nyì, ama nsaiye kwo to ye lo m, ama kwo ɓə jezeɓe.
“Dəye ye ge a ɓwa bwugba wyemwa nya nu. Atukwo ngwnu-tnaaba ɓa zhni apekwnukwnu ngwnu-tnaaba nu, ado n nyikwo ye sasetu n ɓa nyi.
Əɓa nu je asu zhni ngwnu-tnaaba. Ngwnu-atnu ɓá kwu fyí, gbmanyi ye lo, əza n wo ce nyi, wo too ɓe kpa m; ama əsa n wo ɓə ɓe ncei, ɓəshishi nu wo ɓə ɓwa anyìgyi əsa fyewyi nu.
Nyawnanyawna n wo ɓə nyì nsaho, ama nsaiye n wo to ye lo nyi m, əwo nu zhni əsu nyimwanyimwayi. Wo dnalo n əɓa ngwnu-tnaaba yi, wo gnyi woi lo əwo agbmazhniba nu.
“Amwayi ngwnu-awo n ho ɓə gye nyi, ɓa zhni asu ngwnu-awo nu, n ɓa too gwo əɓa abemi kpa m, ama dna n snukna gbmanyi nu n ɓa ɓə gwo ikwo ncei n zhni asu ń kwnusnu n nyawnanyawnai.
Əɓa ɓətukwo gbmanyi nu jesnu ɓa ɓə kwu əɓa kalá n ikwoi ga nyawnanyawnai.
Ba ɓə snukwnú n Kwugyasnáyi, ama Kwugyasnáyi ɓə la myi n əɓa ɓo, ntuge wo zhni adagayi aje Dagayi nu, jesnu asu aje Əsui: jesnu əwo aza ayiyiyi ɓə kwnusnu n woi, əwo avyiyi aknyiknyiyi n agbenuyii.”
Nlonu maləka wa gna mi, “Anuwna n ha gyewye nyi, aba n kaluwa sasetu nyi, ɓa zhni aza nu, deeji yaakwokwo, abye ɓədo n anyitalai.
Nyawnanyawna ɓədo n amwayi ngwnu-awoi n ha gyewye nyi, ɓa ɓə wnunu n kaluwa yii. Ɓa ɓə kwu wo zhniagbma jesnu ɓai fa wo gnyi n ɓwotoloyii; ɓa ɓə gyi əwo nayi jesnu ɓai kpe wo əná.
Ntuge Shekwoyi wo la kwo dna n əɓa ədu ɓa nu əwo ɓəmwi, əsa n ɓa kwu ye nge ɓa ɓá kwu əɓa begyi ikwo ga nyawnanyawnai, nya əsa n Shekwoyi aɓədagbma ɓə kwu nu.
Nyikwoza yi n ho ɓə gye wo əwye nyi, əwo nu zhni əzhiyaakwo n kwo gyibe tu n asu anyì nya.”

N dəye avnu, ma gye maləka ədo woi gbmi shnizhi ɓe ń əshemi. Wo ɓə n ikwo yaakwoi, jesnu anyì ɓaa nu gnyi n bwuznagnai ntu əwo fnufnu yaakwo ɓo.
N bəgye kaladai wa fyiakwu:
“ ‘Kwo la myiya! Kwo la myiya! Babyila Yaakwo kwo la myiya!’
Kwo la zè ase nukwoi afyiba
jesnu zafnu ajegbmiyi dəhodəhoi adnaba,
əlú cegye nya dəhodəhoi pya adnaba,
adnaba ntu afwanya tnagyii wnuwnuiya dəhodəhoi pya.
Ntuge abye vnyanya ɓa kwu anamnuwna nyacei nya sni,
əwo əje nyacei anagbáizhni nya.
Asu əknyi nya, ɓa kwu anagbái zhni n woi,
jesnu agnyikwognyiyi əknyi nya, ɓa kwu nyaɓwa ɓwaɓe n mwa, n kwo kwnu n əwo agbmada wyidui.”
Nlonu ma wo bəgye ədo kwoi gbmi n əshemi kwoi gna:
“ ‘Əmi aza, fye la kwnuya n wo,’
nabai n fye taa dnaɓwa n əwo aleifyi m,
nabai n fye taa gwo əwo əgwnu dəhodəhoi m;
ntuge a la əwo aleifyi takpeaje gwnulo, nya əshemi,
jesnu Shekwoyi wo kwu əwo aɓəkasa aɓo pa.
Jezelo ho ga wo shi a ɓə la ga wo nyi;
a gba wo əta aɓwa aba ntu əɓo ɓo n wo kwu zhni nyi.
A zè ənya fyi wo aɓwa ngwnu-aba, n kwo fyi n əwohni bwoɓyi nyi.
A tu wo azhnì zhowozhowo yi jesnu a ga wo bwugbawnu aɓwa aba
ngye latu n agbmadai wyidui n wo ɓə ga əwohni nyi.
Dna n əwo bwugba, wo gyigbe lo,
‘Mi sasetu n əbeshnikpegye nu n zhni əsu nyikwo.
Mi to zhni nyigbayi nu m,
jesnu mi taa zhni bwugbazhii m nanyinanyi.’
Ntucenu ń nyipyei gbmanyi nu n əwo agwnù ɓə losa wo:
əfyí, bwugbazhii n myikwnujilai.
Əná ɓə kwu wo zhniagbma,
ntuge Dagayi Shekwoyi n wo da wo owa nyi, wo zhni ikwoda nu.
“She asu əknyi nya, n ɓa ɓə zhni anagbái n woi nyi jesnu ɓa kwu aɓwafyi n əwo agbmada wyidui nyi, ɓə gye awú əwo ənakpe nya, ɓa ɓəə ciɓwi jesnu ɓai zhni bwugbazhii ntu əwo ɓo.
Ǹ vnyivnyii ntu ń zhowozhowoi ɓo n wo wo nyi, ɓa ɓə kwu gnyiagnyi zhi n kpaai jesnu ɓa ciɓwi:
“ ‘Owii! Owii n əho aba, əzhiyaakwo,
əho əzhiyaakwo dnagbmai Babyila nya!
Dna n snukna gbmanyi, əho agbmazhni kwo la ɓe!’
“Agnyikwognyiyi əknyi nya ɓa ɓə ciɓwi jesnu ɓai zhni bwugbazhii ntu əwo ɓo, ntuge əzaho to ye si əɓa akaya lo m;
akaya zinali nya, azulufa, akwuta anakwoi n anya manaii; alulu manai, jebwàda, əje luweluwei n əje byeii; sitiron shnuwna dəhodəhoi pya, anya azhnizhnii dəhodəhoi pya n a zhni ɓa n adagba nyiknai, ashnuwna anakwoi, snukna byeii, snukna zhii n akwuta abalu nyai;
akaya sinnamon nya n anyàgba nyai, n anyasnidaii, myiri n frakyisensii, anamnuwna n zaitu omii, wyilukwu ɓyiɓyii n alikamai; anakwo n aknyii; adokwo n akayakwu nyai; n azanyikwocii n a kwnu ɓa n zhni afyenu.
“Ba ɓə gna, ‘Ənya gyigyiyi n ho ɓə gnyi n əkwo fnafnai nyi, kwo la pəya n əho aba. Əfye nyaɓwa vnyanya ɓa la bwusiya, jesnu fye taa shna ɓa wyegye m nanyinanyi.’
Agnyikwognyiyi n ɓa ɓə kwnú anya ye, ɓa ɓwa əɓa nyaɓwa n wo nyi, ɓa ɓə gnyiagnyi zhi n tagnyi, n vnyivnyii ntu əwo azhnìgye zhowozhowo ɓo. Ba ɓə ciɓwi jesnu ɓai zhni bwugbazhii
jesnu ɓai ciɓwi n kalái:
“ ‘Owii! Owii n əho aba, əzhiyaakwo,
n alulu manai ajei kpe, jeɓwada, n byeibyeii,
kwoi bmyana n zinalii, akwuta manai n a Pearii!
Dna n snukna gbmanyi nyaɓwa yaakwo ye kwo kwu zhniagbma!’
“Shikwo tukwoda dəhodəhoi, n azai vnyanya n ɓa znazna n əya nuwnanyai, ayadnayi, jesnu n azai vnyanya n ɓa ɓwa nyagyi n əya nuwnanya tnutnu nyi, ɓa ɓə gnyagnyi zhi n kpaai.
She ɓa ɓə gye awú əkwo ənagyi nya, ɓa ɓə gna, ‘Əzhiyaakwo ədo ɓə shnisnu ngye əzhiyaakwo dnagbmai ye?’
Ɓa ɓə kwu aɓwutukwnu kpe n əɓa atukwo, jesnu ɓai ciɓwi ɓai zhni bwugbazhii ɓai gna:
“ ‘Owii! Owii n əho aba, əzhiyaakwo,
aba n aza vnyanya n ɓa ɓə n ayanuwna nyai kpe n shikwo
ɓa kwu agyiwye ɓwa n əkwo nyaɓwa!
N snukna gbmanyi a kwu wo zhniagbma!’
“Fye nya agbmada tu n kwo, ashemi!
Nya agbmada, əfye, Shekwoyi aza!
Fye nya agbmada atnutnuloyi n sheaɓəgwognayii!
Shekwoyi wo kwu owa da wo,
n owai, n nyikwo yi ɓe znutu fye nyi.”
Nlonu maləka yaakwo wa la kwuta dnagbmai nsnu ngye ata wyigwo nya jesnu wa she kwo ya dna n shikwo, wa gna:
“N akaláɓəzhni ye pyai nu
n a ɓa she əzhiyaakwo Babyila ya shi n əknyi,
jesnu to ai je əkwo əwyegye m kpeekpe.
Amwulo snáyi, anyagyiyi, n amwayi bye yii,
a taa je ɓa wo dna n ho m kpeekpe.
A taa je aɓwaze tnutnuyi dəhodəhoi nya
gye dna n ho m kpeekpe.
A taa je atá wyigwo nya ashna wo dna n ho m kpeekpe.
Bwuznagna pyitila nya
taa je fnu dna n ho m kpeekpe.
A taa je bəgye mwulaɓa n mwulanyikwo nyai wo
dna n ho m kpeekpe.
Əho aɓwazeyi nu ɓə zhni aza adnagbmai n anyì vnyanya.
N əho ashigbe zhnii nu n abye vnyanya ɓə ɓwuaba.
Dna n kwo nu n a ɓə gye sheaɓəgwognayi ami n Shekwoyi aza agyigyiyi nyai,
aza vnyanya n a la ɓa gbeashaya fyi n anyi.”

N dəye avnu ma wo kəsnu n kwo ɓə wo ngye wyiɓe deeji yaakwo nya n əshemi n kalái:
“Haliluya!
Gnyignyi n latui n kalái
ɓa zhni əyi Shekwoyi nya nu,
ntuge əho awada ɓa zhni gaiciya nu jesnu n cefyé.
Wo la kaluwa yaakwo ye znuknyi n wo ɓə wnu əknyi ya n əwo anagbáizhniyi nyi.
Wo kwu əwo atnutnuyi ami gbata n nyikwo yi.”
Njesnu ɓa je əwyiɓe:
“Haliluya!
Awú əwo ənagyi nya, ɓa gwnulo əshe lo
nyalonyalo.”
Azakwoyi shiiba-ceanyi jesnu n anyawyewyeyi ngwnu-anyi ɓa yazhi ɓa ci Shekwoyi, əza n wo ɓə sasetu n əbeshnikpegye. Njesnu ɓa fyiakwu: “Aamyi, Haliluya!”
Nlonu bəgye kwa gbmiɓe n əbeshnikpegye, kwoi gna:
“Fye ci əyi Shekwoyi,
əfye vnyanya əwo atnutnuyi,
əfye n fye wo wo ədna nyi,
aɓyinawyiyi n aza yaakwoi!”
Nlonu ma wo kəsnu ngye deeji yaakwo nya, ngye avava nuwna wyiɓe ɓədo ngye ogbma awyisa, kwoi ɓəwyi:
“Haliluya!
Ntuge əyi Dagayi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya gyibe lo.
Fa ya dagbma
jesnu a da yi ya ga wo latu!
Ntuge Kwugyasnáyi mwulapa kwo la ɓe,
jesnu əwo Mwulanyikwo wo la əwohni ye.
Aje-luweluwe n fnafnai jesnu n gyigyiyi n shana ya,
a kwu ga wo wa kpe.”
(Alulu manai aje, ɓa zhi ɓai wu Shekwoyi aza agyigyiyi aɓəfyecezhni atnutnu nu.)
Nlonu maləka wa gna mi, “Ka dəye: Aza anabəlikada nu n a kwu Kwugyasnáyi amwula nyagyi pa ɓa!” Njesnu waa əɓo ɓe, “Adəye nu zhni Shekwoyi aɓədagbma hnihnii.”
N dəye dadai, ma yashi n əwo apitabwada aba nabai ma ga wo mwamwa. Ama wa gna mi, “To zhni ce m! Mi zhni tnutnuyi nu ce n kwnusnu n hoi n əho azajei ɓədo n əho amapwii n ɓa n Yeisu ɓəgbmii shiɓwa nyi. Ga Shekwoyi mwamwa! Ntuge Zafnu sheɓəgwogna nya nu zhni Yeisu ɓəgbmiyi.”
Ma gye əshemi n gwuya gnyi jesnu ma gye dokwo bwui n gnyi n abaayi, ai yi əkwo gwnuyi ge, Gbenuyi jesnu Gaiciyayi. N ɓəfyecei nu n wo da owa jesnu woi snukwnú.
Əwo awye wulo ngye əná-gwogwoi, jesnu wo ɓə n afnunyi bəgyéi kwnu n əwo tukwo. Wo ɓə n əyei ka tu n əwohni, ń əzahozahoyi ta kpe kwo əye lo m, akpe əwo n əwohnii.
Wo n ajei kpe lo n a kwu ɓa dafyi n ami, jesnu ai yi əwo əye ge Shekwoyi Ɓədagbma.
Əshemi akwnuyi ɓə laɓa ɓai vyi wo, ɓa ɓə kpe n adokwo bwui jesnu n ajei kpe alulu manai bwuibwui gyigyiyi nya.
Əbeyaakwo n gyígyiyi kwoi gbmiɓe n əwo əgbe ədo n wo ɓa znu abye knyi ncei. “Wo ɓə gyibe tu ɓa n snukna bwusii.” Wo dna anamnuwnapyiba Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya minagyi nazhii nya.
Tu n əwo əje-kpadalai ɓədo n əwo bwuzhikwoi, wo n əye yéi ka tu lo:
Asu aje Əsu jesnu adagayi aje Dagayii.
Jesnu ma gye maləka n gnyiagnyi dna n nyipyei, n wo ɓə dnawyi n bəgye yaakwoi ga alú vnyanya n ɓa gyeafu kpe n anyìbmana, “Fye ɓe, fya yezhi n aba gbmanyi ntu wyeshenyagyi yaakwo Shekwoyi nya ɓo,
nabai n fye ɓa myi fya gyi asu abwu, akwnudawazha, ɓədo n aza akaládai, adokwo ɓədo n əɓa agwnuyii, ɓədo n aza vnyanya abwui, aloloiya ɓədo n afyenuyii, azayaakwo n aɓyinawyii.”
Nlonu ma gye nyawnanyawna ɓədo n asu əknyi nyai, n əɓa akwnuyii, n yezhi n abagbmanyi nabai ɓa snukwnú n dokwo gwnuyii ɓədo n əwo akwnuyii.
Ama a ɓə la nyawnanyawnai wna, ɓədo n sheɓəgwognayi katái, əza n wo ɓə wu aznù n əkwo apitaɓwi. N aznù yei wa fyi aza kwoce n ɓa ɓə la nyawnanyawnai aznù gwo jesnu ɓa ga əkwo dogbe jijiyi mwamwa. Əɓa ngwnu-aba a ɓə kwu ɓa sheya fyi n wyewyeyii, n əná-znudna solufo nya.
Aza n ɓa ɓə ce nyi, a wu ɓa n əbeyaakwoi n kwo ɓə gbmiɓe n dokwo gwnuyi əgbe, jesnu alú afugyeyi vnyanya ɓa gyi əɓa abwu, nubwo kwa kwu ɓa fu n.

Njesnu ma gye maləka woi gbmi shnizhi n əshemi, n ɓwokwnu loloyi anyagwunyai shi jesnu n agbma yaakwoi shi n əwo akwnu.
Wa wna tumise fnyakwnufnyakwnu, owa sapa nya, əwo nu zhni gwuzhenyi, kwo Shetam, waa wo pa aye dugwu gbmanyi.
Waa wo sheya dna n ɓwokwnu loloyi, jesnu waa kwo gwu, waa kwo tuznù, nabai to wa fyi aknyi kwoce njesnu m, nya aye dugwu gbmanyi zozo. N dəye avnu, ɓəshishi nu ai la wo loya n ɓwasnu n əsai fyewyi.
Ma kwu gye abeshnikpegye, aza yi n ɓa ɓə sase kpe n ɓa, a ɓə kwu ikwoi ga ɓa, ɓa da owa. Njesnu ma gye aza yi wyewyeyi əwye n a ɓə la ɓa kpmiatukwo ntu əɓa ɓəgbmi ɓo tu n Yeisu tukwo jesnu n Shekwoyi ɓədagbmai. Ɓa to ɓə ga nyawnanyawna mwamwa kwo əkwo dogbei m, jesnu ɓa to ɓə gwo əkwo aznù tu n əɓa nyikwnumi kwo n əɓa aɓwa m. Ɓa kwu əɓa wyewyeyi jeɓwa, jesnu ɓa gyibe n kwnusnu n Kirisitii aye dugwu gbmanyi.
(Azafyí n ɓa ce nyi, ɓa to ɓə shna wyewyeyi ɓwa m, nya əsa aye dugwu gbmanyi zozo.) Dəye nu zhni kalakwu kpmisnuyi.
Anabəlikada nu njesnu agyigyiyi nu, n aza yii n ɓa ɓə kwu fyi n kalakwu kpmisnuyi. Əfyí baayi to n kalái lo tu n ɓa m, ama ɓa ɓə kwu zhni Shekwoyi apirisiti nu ɓədo n Kirisiti nyai jesnu ɓai gyibe n kwnusnu n woi aye dugwu gbmanyi.
Əsa n aye dugwu gbmanyi ɓə la duya, a ɓə gbmi Shetam ya n əwo zhalu
Njesnu wo ɓə gbmiya laɓa woi fyi abye kwoce n anyì aɓwakwonu ngwnu-anyi, Gwog n Magogii, woi ye ɓa zhi ntu okwnu ɓo. N namba, əɓa bəgyé wulo ngye amwi nu, kpe n shikwo əgbe.
Ɓa tufye lo nya anyìpata jesnu ɓa kwu she Shekwoyi aza apyiznudna gwnu, əzhiyaakwo n wo ɓə ye kwo nyi. Ama əná kwa kwnuɓe n əshemi kwa gyi ɓa ɓwutuu.
Njesnu gwuzhenyi, n wo ɓə dna ɓa kwoce nyi, aa wo sheya dna n əná-znudna n kwo gyina n solufoi, aba ń a ɓə n nyawnanyawna ɓədo n sheɓəgwognayi katái nyai sheya fyi nyi. Ɓa ɓə kwu fyi n zhowozhowoi n nyipyei n sukwoi nyalonyalo.
Nlonu ma gye əbeshnikpegye bwuibwui yaakwo jesnu n əzai n wo ɓə sasetu n kwo nyi. Əknyi ɓədo n əshei ɓai bwusiya n əwo awyeba, jesnu to ɓa ɓwa azhi ba m.
Njesnu ma gye azafyifyiyi, azayaakwo n anawyii, n gnyiagnyi zhi n əbeshnikpegye abye, jesnu a kpe apafyi ya. A kpe pafyi ədo ya, n əkwo nu zhni pafyi wyewyeyi nya nyi. A da azafyifyiyi owa vyi ənya n ɓa ɓə kwu zhni ngye she kwo ɓə kafyi n apafyi nyi.
Shikwo kwa ga əkwo azafyifyiyi n ɓa ɓə fyi n kwo nyi, jesnu əfyí ɓədo n akwui ɓa ga əɓa azafyifyiyi n ɓa ɓə fyi n ɓa, jesnu a da zahozahoyi owa vyi əɓo n wo ɓə kwu zhni.
Nlonu əfyí n akwui a sheɓaya fyi n əná-znudna. Əná-znudna nu zhni əfyí baayi.
Zahozahoyi n a to ɓə gye əwo əye əwye n ka dna n pafyi wyewyeyi nya m, a ɓə la wo sheya dna n əná-znudna.

Nlonu ma gye “əshemi woiwoyi əwye n əknyi woiwoyii,” ntuge əshemi kpmisnui n əknyi kpmisnuii ɓa ɓə la duya jesnu shikwo ho to ɓə ye shnasnu m.
Ma gye Əzhiyaakwo Gyigyiyi, Urishelima woiwoyi, kwoi gbmiɓe n əshemi n Shekwoyi aba, n əkwohnii zhni nyigwnu n bmyabmyai ngye mwulanyikwo ntu əwo əɓa ɓo.
Jesnu ma wo bəgye n latu kwoi gbmi n əbeshnikpegye kwoi gna, “Shiawye! Nsaiye Shekwoyi aseseba kwo la kwnusnu n azanyikwocii, jesnu wo ɓa kwnudna n ɓai. Ɓa ɓə kwu zhni əwo aza, jesnu Shekwoyi n əwohni tukwoi wo ɓə kwnusnu n ɓai woi la zhni əɓa Shekwoyi.
Wo ɓə wnu awyenyi dəhodəhoi ya n əɓa awyeba. A to ɓə je əfyí gye m, kwo bwugbazhii kwo ɓwuci kwo snasna m, ntuge anya akwokwoi vnyanya ɓa la duya.”
Əza n wo ɓə sasetu n əbeshnikpegye nyi wa gna, “Mi gnyi mii zhni nyahonyahoi kwa zhni woiwoyi nu!” Nlonu wa gna, “Kwu dəye ka shi, ntuge aɓədagbma ye kwnukpema lo, jesnu n zhni gaiciya.”
Wa gna mi: “A kwu kwo zhni. Əmi nu zhni Kpmisnuyi n Kpmaknayii. Əza n wo n nuwna myikwnui, mi ɓə ga wo nuwna wa sni ntna gyiwyegbai, nuwna pyipyii wyewyeyi nya.
Aza n ɓa ɓə gyi nasala, ɓa ɓə ɓwa anya ye vnyanya əgwu, jesnu mi ɓə la zhni əɓa Shekwoyi, ɓa ɓə kwu zhni əmi aɓyi.
Ama adnawoyi, atnagaiciyagayi, awyeɓwoyi, azawuyii, aɓənyashnada, aza yi n ɓa tu agbákwnu gyifyi nya mwi, ashnagbayi n akataceyii vnyanya; əɓa afyiba nu ɓə gnyi n ənaznudnai solufo nya. Dəye nu zhni əfyí baayi.”
Maləka gbmanyi dna n amaləka tnaaba yi, n wo ɓə n ashnapa ngwnu-tnaabai shi nyi n nunui n agwnù tnaaba kpmaknyaii nyi, wa ɓe wa gna mi, “Ɓe, ma wu ho Mwulanyikwo, Kwugyasnáyi nyikwo.”
Njesnu wa la mi lo ncei dna n Zafnu lo əpeyaakwo asnada, wa wu mi Əzhiyaakwo Gyigyiyi, Urishelima, kwoi shnizhi ɓe n əshemi kwoi gbmi n Shekwoyi aba.
Kwoi bmyana n latu Shekwoyi nyai, jesnu əkwo ənabmya ɓə wu ngye kwuta manai dudui nu, ngye jaspa, n knaknaiya təgetəge.
Kwo ɓə n gəlu yaakwo asnadai, n abwokwnumii ngwnu-awoceaba, n amaləkai ngwnu-awoceaba n zhi n abwokwnumi. Israila abye ngwnu-awoceaba aye ɓə kakpe n abwokwnumi.
Abwokwnumi ɓəə knyi ngwnu-ata n anyipyei kpəkwó, ngwnu-ata n snukwó, ngwnu-ata n snutakwo jesnu ngwnu-ata n shnikwó.
Gəlu əzhiyaakwo nya ɓə n ashnipai kpeaje ngwnu-awoceaba jesnu, Kwugyasnáyi atnutnuloyi ngwnu-awoceaba aye ɓə kakpe n ɓa.
Maləka n wo ɓə daɓo n mii nyi, ɓə n abamwi-bwusii shi zinali nya wa mwi əzhiyaakwo yi, əkwo abwokwnumi n əkwo agəlui.
Əzhiyaakwo yi ɓə gnyi n asəpai ngwnu-anyi nu, əkwo əkpa nsnu dəidəi n əkwo patai. Wa mwi əzhiyaakwo yi n bwusi abamwi-bwusii, wa ɓwa akilomita 2,200 n əkpa, jesnu pata n asnai ngye əkwo əkpa.
Maləka wa mwi gəlu n zanyikwoci ɓwashai wa gye ɓa nyi amita n shnishni, woi zhni apma n zanyikwoci nyamwunyai, kwo ɓə nyi tagyi-gbmanyi ncei kpe shiinyiceanyi (144) nu n əɓwasha shnishni.
A ɓə mi gəlu n jaspa akwutái nu, jesnu əzhiyaakwo n zinali tnadodnai nu, n wu təgetəge ngye maganyi.
Ashnipa əzhiyaakwo gəlu nya ɓə zhniaba gnyi n kwuta manai dəhodəhoi pyai. Jaspa nu ɓə zhni shnipa kpmisnui, baayi sapyiya, taayi agate, nyiiyi emyeral,
tnuuyi onis, tnaanyii rubyi, tnaaba yi kirisolait, nyimwanyimwai beril, ciwagbmanyii topaz, ngwunu-nwoyi turkuois, woceigbmanyii jasinti, jesnu wocei-baayi ametis.
Abwokwnumi awoceaba ɓə zhni n anyai n a yi ge pyeril awoceaba nya nu, abwokwnumi dəhodəhoi ncei zhni n pyeril ɓwugyi. Adnadna yakwo əzhiyaakwo nya ɓə zhni zinalii nu n tnadodnai ngye maganyi.
Mi to ɓəə gye Dagayipwuwa n əzhiyaakwoi m, ntuge Dagayi Shekwoyi Kaláda Duduyi Vnyanya, n Kwugyasnáyi əɓa nu zhni əkwo Dagayipwuwa.
Əzhiyaakwo ye ta ye nyipyei bwuznagna lo kwo əpya nya kwa fnukpe n əkwo m, ntuge latu Shekwoyi nya ga kwo bwuznagna njesnu Kwugyasnáyi nu zhni əkwo pyitila.
Abye ɓə znazna n əkwo bwuznagnai nu, njesnu asu anyi nya ɓa ɓə ɓe n əɓa bmyabmyai fyi n kwo.
Wyiho to lo n a ɓə gwu əkwo abwokwnumi m nanyinanyi, ntuge a to ɓə gye sukwo n ɓo m.
A ɓə ɓe n latui ɓədo n mwamwa abye nyai fyi n kwo.
Nyahonyahoi ntnagyiyi, to ɓə lodna n kwo m, kwo əza n wo zhni əɓo n kwo n vnyinkwoi kwo kwocedna m, ama aza yi nu ɓwasnu n əɓa aye kafyilo n Kwugyasnáyi pafyi wyewyeyi nya.

Nlonu maləka wa wu mi əlà nuwna wyewyeyi nya, n wu təgetəge ngye maganyi, kwoi zhe n Shekwoyi əbeshnikpegye ɓədo n Kwugyasnáyii
kwoi shnizhi n atasnii dnadna yaakwo nya n əzhiyaakwo yi. Ma ń əlà-akpma ngwnu-aba-aba nya, shnuwna wyewyeyi nya ɓə gnyi, kwoi ga anyanunu gyigyi awoceaba, kwoi ga əkwo gyigyi n əpya dəhodəhoii. Njesnu shnuwna yi əkwo afnyitolo ɓə zhni shigbe kágna nya nu ntu abye ɓo.
A to ɓə je knyitu dəhodəhoi wyegye m. Ntuge Shekwoyi əbeshnikpegye n Kwugyasnáyi nyai kwo ɓə dna n əzhiyaakwo, jesnu əwo atnutnuyi ɓa ɓə zhni wo tnutnu.
Ba ɓə gye əwo awyeba əwye, jesnu a ɓə kwu əwo əye kakpe n əɓa anyikwnumi.
Sukwo to ɓə jezhni m. Ɓa to ɓə shna pyitila bwuznagna apma ɓwa, kwo nyipyei bwuznagna m, ntuge Dagayi Shekwoyi ɓə ga ɓa bwuznagna. Jesnu ɓa ɓə gyibe nyalonyalo nya.
Maləka wa gna mi, “Aɓədagbma ye n kwnuce a shiɓwa jesnu gaiciya nu. Dagayi, Shekwoyi n wo dna sheaɓəgwognayi bwugbakala n zafnu nyi, əwo nu ɓə tnu n əwo maləkai wa wu əwo atnutnuyi aɓo n ɓa zhni ɓəshishi nu ɓa zhni n tna əsa wnuyai.”
“Shiawye, mi ɓe lo n tna əsa wnuyai! Anabəlikada nu n əzai n wa shi aɓədagbma sheaɓəgwognayi nya n ɓa kafyi n əpakpmikpmii ye nyi.”
Əmi, Yohana, əmi nu ɓə wo jesnu ma gye aɓo ye əwye. Əsa n mi ɓə kwu aɓo ye wo jesnu mii kwu ɓa gyewye, ma yashi nabai ma ga maləka mwamwa n wo ɓə gnyi woi wu mi aɓo ye nyi.
Ama wa gna mi, “To zhni ce m! Mi zhni tnutnuyi nu ce n kwnusnu n hoi ɓədo n əho sheɓəgwognayi ajei ɓədo n azai vnyanya n ɓa shi aɓədagbma əpakpmikpmii ye nya əɓwa nyi. Ga Shekwoyi nu mwamwa!”
Nlonu wa gna mi, “To la aɓədagbma sheɓəgwogna əpakpmikpmii nya ye tuznu m, ntuge əsa la wo vyivyiwyi.
Fa əza n wo zhni ɓəkasa wo gwodu n əwo ɓəkasazhnii; əza n wo wnuwnuiya wo gwodu dna n əwo wnuwnuya; əza n wo zhni ɓəfyece wo gwodu n əwo ɓəfyecezhnii; jesnu əza n wo gyigyiyi wo gwodu dna n əwo gyigyi.”
“Shiawye, mi ɓe lo n tna əsa wnuyai! Əmi gyiba shilo n mii, jesnu mi ɓə ga zahozahoyi kwo she wo ɓə zhni əwo atnutnu n wu.
Əmi nu zhni kpmisnuyi n kpmaknayii, Ayayaba n Azobai.
“Anabəlikada nu n aza yii n ɓa zhna əɓa aje, nabai n ɓa ɓə myi ɓa ɓwa ikwo ɓa ɓwa shnuwna wyewyeyi nya jesnu ɓai lofyi n əzhiyaakwo abwokwnumi.
Amwi nu zhi n əbmyi, aza n ɓa snu-ashna, asisiɓozhniyi, azawuyi, ashnagbayi ɓədo n azai vnyanya n ɓa ye jesnu ɓai ceakata.
“Əmi, Yeisu, mi la tnu n əmi maləkai wa ga fye ɓəgbmi ye ga aikilisiya. Əmi nu zhni Gbegye ɓədo n Dawuda Yawyii. Əmi nu zhni Mwukwo Kpasi Laabmi nya.”
Zafnu ɓədo n mwula nyikwoi gna lo, “Ɓe!” Njesnu fa əza n wo wo lo, wo gna, “Ɓe!” Zahozahoyi n nuwna myikwnu wo wo lo, wo ɓe, jesnu əza n wo ncei pmalo, wa gwo nyaga nuwna wyewyeyi nya wo ɓe wa gwo n adaada.
Mi ga zahozahoyi ɓəkwnu n wo wo aɓədagbma sheɓəgwogna əpakpmikpmii ye nya: əza n wa ɓe ənya n ɓa, Shekwoyi ɓə ɓe əza yi ogwnu n a ncei kafyi n əpakpmikpmii ye.
Njesnu ndei əzaho wa kwnu aɓədagbma ya n ɓa fyi n əpakpmikpmii sheɓəgwogna ye nya, Shekwoyi ɓə gbmi nyahonyahoi ya n əza yi ɓə kwnu gwo n shnuwna wyewyeyi nya ɓədo n Əzhiyaakwo Gyigyiyii, shi a ncei kafyilo n əpakpmikpmii ye nyi.
Əza n wo gbmiɓo tu n aɓo ye nyi, wo gna, “Əə, mi ɓe lo ntna əsa wnuyai.” Aamyi. Ɓe Dagayi Yeisu.
Shebmyashi Dagayi Yeisu nya ɓa kwnusnu n Shekwoyi azai. Aamyi.

About the Gbagyi Contemporary Bible
Gbagyi Nyizeyenya Baibwulu: Shekwoyi Ɓədagbma kwo n əwyei wna lo n Gbagyi əbye n a zhniapma ncei n nyizeye, jesnu n əɓoi n a ye ntu bmapmyi doloi ɓo, kwoi vyi baibwulu abye kpmisnui nya nabai n kwo ɓa ga anyabayi əkwo ɓəda shi kwo kwnuce. A n kwoi ka lo n snasnaiya, əbyeshnishniiya n doloi, ɓədo n tnadoshna ɓozhnii, n kwo fa ɓədagbma kwa daɓo n Gbagyiza nyizeyenya nyabayi ədui. Kwo to kpema lo n ikilisiya ɓwala ho nyawu nu m, ama a n Ɓədagbmai pmyibma n shnisnusnu n zhni Shekwoyi ɓədatnu nu tna əsatui nya ga zanyikwoci. Kwo zhni ɓəhoɓəhoi kwa gye ge aza vnyanya ɓa kwu ɓədatnu gənyikpe ɓwa. Bmapmyi ye ɓətukwo, əkwo nu ge, a gye Gbagyi nyabayi dəhodəhoi dna n Najeriya ɓədo n Agbagyii n ɓa zhni azhiɓeyi fyilo n aknyido ɓa ɓe da Kirisiti jesnu ɓa mwa fyi n gaiciyaga n ɓədatnui.
— — — — — —
The Gbagyi Contemporary Bible (Gbagyi Nyizeyenya Baibwulu: Shekwoyi Ɓədagbma) considered the contemporary language use and the need for accuracy of translating the original biblical languages to meet the need of Gbagyi readers. It is written in a clear, natural, accurate and consistent manner which allows the Word speak to the heart of the contemporary reader. It is not denominationally biased, but translates the Word primarily as the timeless message of God to mankind. It makes every effort to ensure that the message is understandable to all people. This edition is aimed at seeing every Gbagyi reader in Nigeria and the diaspora come to Christ and grow in faith through its message.

Biblica zhni anyìvnyanya ɓəvyitnutnu nu, n kwo kwnu Abaibwulu ɓe ncei ń azokwo awoiwoyii. Gbari
Gwari is a Nupoid language spoken by the Gbagyi people, which make up over a million people in Nigeria . There are two principal varieties, Gbari (West Gwari) and Gbagyi (East Gwari), which have some difficulty in communication; sociolinguistically they are distinct languages.
Phonology
Vowels
/i, u, e, o/ can also have allophones [ɪ, ʊ, ɛ, ʌ].
Nasal vowels /ĩ, ũ, ẽ, õ/ can also be heard as [ɪ̃, ʊ̃, ɛ̃, ʌ̃].
Consonants
The following sounds may be labialized as /pʷ, bʷ, fʷ, vʷ, kʷ, ɡʷ, mʷ, k͡pʷ, ɡ͡bʷ, hʷ/ and palatalized as /pʲ, bʲ, fʲ, vʲ, kʲ, ɡʲ, mʲ, lʲ, wʲ/.
Sounds /t, d, s, z, n/ when palatalized are always heard as [tʃ, dʒ, ʃ, ʒ, ɲ].
Sounds /f, b/ can be heard as bilabial sounds [ɸ, β] in free variation.
/n/ is heard as velar [ŋ] when preceding velar consonants.
/n/ becomes a labialized-velar [ŋʷ] when preceding a /w/.
Sounds /bʷ, ɡʷ, ɡʲ/ are softened to fricatives [βʷ, ɣʷ, ɣʲ] when preceding a glide, in medial-intervocalic position.
/ɡ͡b/ is heard as an implosive [ɓ] in free variation.
/h/ only has a limited occurrence, but it also may be allophonic with /f/ in Northern Gbagyi. In Southern Gbagyi, [h] is heard in free variation with /j/, when /j/ occurs before /i/ in syllable-final position.
The palatalized /lʲ/ may also be heard as a central glide [ɹ]. [ 2 ]
The following sounds may be labialized as /pʷ, bʷ, fʷ, vʷ, kʷ, ɡʷ, mʷ/ and palatalized as /pʲ, bʲ, fʲ, vʲ, tʲ, dʲ, kʲ, ɡʲ, mʲ, lʲ, wʲ/.
Stops may also be heard as post-nasalized as [pᵐ, bᵐ, tⁿ, dⁿ, kᵑ, ɡᵑ, k͡pᵐ, ɡ͡bᵐ].
Palatalized sounds /tʲ, dʲ/, typically occur as [tʃ, dʒ] or [tʲ, dʲ] in free variation, and as [tʃ, dʒ], they can be represented orthographically as . Sounds /s, z, n/ when palatalized are always heard as [ʃ, ʒ, ɲ], and can be represented orthographically as .
Sounds /f, fʲ, b/ can be heard as bilabial sounds [ɸ, ɸʲ, β] in free variation.
/d/ can also be heard as [ɾ].
Sounds /b, ɡ/ and /bʷ, ɡʷ, ɡʲ/ are softened to fricatives [β, ɣ] and [βʷ, ɣʷ, ɣʲ] when preceding a glide, in medial-intervocalic position.
/n/ becomes a labialized-velar [ŋʷ] when preceding a /w/.
The palatalized /lʲ/ may also be heard in free variation, as a central glide [ɹ] or as a palatalized equivalent [ɹʲ].
/n/ when palatalized is heard as a palatal nasal [ɲ], and is velar as [ŋ] when preceding velar consonants. [ 3 ]
Varieties
Gbagye is also known as Gwari-Matai or Gwarin Ngenge , which are recently adopted cover terms. [ 4 ]
There are two separate Gbagyi groups living in: [ 4 ]
Minna and Kuta (more prominent group)
around Diko , northeast of Suleja
Gbagye is the only Nupoid language that has the bilabial implosive /ɓ/. [ 4 ]
Gbagyi (also known as Gwari ) is a cover term for all the Gbari-speaking peoples, and includes many varieties. [ 4 ]
Gbari-Yama is a cover term used for all southern Gbari dialects. There are two closely related dialects, which are: [ 4 ]
Shigokpna
Zubakpna
Gbedegi is an extinct language (possibly a Nupe dialect) spoken near Mokwa (Nadel 1941). [ 4 ]

History
Social-political structure
Historically, the Gbagyi/Gbari practice a patrilineal kinship system. [ 7 ] The lowest tier of authority is found in the extended family compound led by the oldest male. Being a patriarchal community, the Osu (king) is the highest tier of authority in a Gbagyi/Gbari settlement and he is assisted by a group of elders who are charged with the responsibility of ensuring peace in the land. [ 8 ]
Women historically have been known to carry things on their shoulders instead of their heads. This is because it is believed that since the head is the "King of the entire body", you should not carry anything normal on it. [ 9 ]
Additionally, Gbagyi familiarity with the lapis lazuli stone has been taken in some quarters as indication of Egyptian origin. The question of Gbagyi origin is further complicated by the fact that the Nupe and Gbagyi languages have recognised affinity and the Koro, whose history seems to have been intricately linked with that of the Gbagyi, actually claim linkage with Wukari and the Kwarafara empire (Cadman, 1913). [ 10 ]
Settlement
The Gbagyi people are found in various locations in Middle Belt (Central) Nigeria. They inhabit the western parts of Abuja , southern Niger State , Chikun Local Government Area with its headquarters at Kujama in Kaduna state and Nassarawa state . [ 11 ] Significant Gbagyi towns include Minna , Karu, Kuta, Kwakuti, Kwali , Gawu, Yelwa, Toto , Araba, Nakuse, Rubochi, Abaji, Geku, Gadabuje, Majaga, (Gusolo) Gussoro, (Gbada) Gwada, Guni, Fuka, Galkogo, Maikunkele, Manta, Wushapa (Ushafa), Bisi, Bwaya (Bwari), Suleja , Shiroro (Shilolo), Beji, Diko, Alawa, Erena, Paiko/ Paigo, Lambata, Zugba, Nuku, Gbogo and Farin Doki. There are some theories that posit a reason for the scattered settlements and migration of the Gbagyi people. Some historians believe the Gbagyi were displaced from their original settlements during the Fulani Jihad , while some local historians link migration with the need for farmland by the Gbagyi. [ 12 ] Chigudu, pp. 1–2
Gbagyi settlements can be both large and small. In locations where farming is the dominant occupation, the settlements tend to be small so that enough land is available for farming.
Displacement from lands in Abuja
The Gbagyi were the largest among the ethnic groups that inhabited the land proposed for development when Abuja was chosen as Nigeria's new federal capital. The result was dislocation, the removal of people from their ancestral homes, from spiritual symbols such as Zuma Rock , [ 13 ] seeing their ancestral land referred to as no-man's land, and issues about adjusting to the new environment given by the government. However, many displaced families were given housing, but some lived in transit and settlement camps for a long while.
Culture
The Gbagyi people are known to be peace-loving, transparent and accommodating people. Northerners are fond of saying in Hausa language muyi shi Gwari Gwari , "let’s do it like the Gbagyi" or "in the Gbagyi way". According to Theophilus Tanko Chigudu, the Gbagyi people have emerged as a unique breed among Nigerians: their culture shows how much they have come to terms with the universe. Daily they aspire to give life a meaning no matter the situation in which they find themselves. [ 14 ] The name Gbagyi has been linked with many meanins such as "benevolence, ingenuity, reliability, magnanimity, allegiance, and a profound inclination towards familial relationships. The Gbagyi ethnic group is renowned for their distinct propensity to embrace others, their openness, and their dedication to promoting harmony." [ 15 ]
Language
The Gbagyi language is part of the Kwa sub-division of the Niger-Congo language family, [ 16 ] however, some researchers such as Kay Williamson put the language in the Benue-Congo family . [ 17 ] The people speak two dialects that are sometimes called Gbari (Gwari yamma) and Gbagyi dialects.
Religion
The Gbagyi people are typically adherents of the Christian faith, however a growing subset practice Islam and their own traditional religion. In their traditional religion, some Gbagyi believe in a God called Shekwoyi (one who was there before their ancestors) [ 18 ] but they also devote themselves to appeasing deities such as Maigiro. [ 19 ] Many Agbagyi believe in reincarnation.
The rapid growth of Christianity was due to the Sudan Interior Mission (which also came to be known locally as Evangelical Church of West Africa now Evangelical Church Winning All) and the Baptist Missionaries from the south western part of Nigeria. [ 20 ] Islam first appeared in the region around the 18th-19th centuries due to the impact of the Fula jihads but it was during the colonial and post-colonial period which saw most actual conversions to Islam among the Gbagyi. [ 21 ] [ 20 ]
Arts
Pottery
Pottery is passed down matrilinially as it is considered to be a woman's role and craft. [ 22 ] The clay is harvested with hoes and hand-sorted. Women often work with their children especially girls when collecting the clay. [ 23 ] Women knead the clay by hand and use wooden shaping materials and old knifes to shape the clay. Dried clay or fine sand is sometimes used to help the consistency of the clay when it is too soft. Gwari potters do not use pottery wheels but instead use the pinching and coiling method, This is done by layering coils of clay on top of each other to build up the shape of the object being created. Decorating the pots is simple, similar to cloth decoration. Because pottery is considered magical and important, there are specific rules that need to be followed when sourcing the clay. Women who are pregnant or on their period cannot go to the claypits and broken Calabash cannot be used to get the clay. Different pots are made for different purpose in Nigerian culture, some for everyday use and others for rituals. There are three main types of pots, Randa, Tulu, and Kasko, who all have their own uses. [ 23 ]
The Gwarin Yamma are specialists in making randa pots.Characterized by a wide mouth, short neck, and narrow rim,it is the largest style of pot at about 20-30 gallons, made specifically for storing drinking water. However, during ceremonies, these randas can be used for storing Giya (beer). [ 23 ]
Tulu are used for storing giya. They can be many different sizes with long necks, fat bellies, and narrow mouths and wide, flat rims. They are never used for anything other than beer storage. The giya that is stored is considered safe from evil spirits touching it over night, and they tulu's are used to give offerings to the juju (gods) they worship. [ 23 ]
Kasko pots can be many shapes and sizes. They are used for either storing water, oil, meat or fish, and salt or it can be used for cooking or serving food. Grain can be stored in giant kaskos and can be used to carry water home from the river. [ 23 ]
The Pottery Training Centre (PTC) in Abuja was founded by Micheal Cardew in 1952. It was originally a center for only men to learn pottery, even though it is a traditionally female craft. [ 23 ] Edward Harland Duckworth wanted to have Nigerian pottery rival Japanese and Czechoslovak wares and encouraged more industry in Nigeria. Cardew started with small scale workshops before August 1951 when the site for the PTC was found. Since 1951, the PTC has been funded by the government through the Ministry of Trade and Industry. [ 23 ]
Ladi Kwali also known as Lady Kwali was the first female student in 1954 and paved the way for many more women such as Magdalene Odundo , a ceramist born in Kenya, who studied at the PTC in 1974. She met Ladi Kwali there and she was greatly influenced by her. [ 22 ] Ladi Kwali graduated the PTC in 1959 and became an employee for the centre. [ 24 ]
Traditional cloth
The Gbagyi people wear two types of traditional cloth. Old dark blue cloth is worn by many generations. The cloth is traditionally worn around private parts, but now in post colonial times, the blue cloth is used for pants and skirts and worn with white shirts The newer cloth is black and white. These fabrics have pictures of women carrying things on their shoulders. Written on the cloth is the words "Mizhin Gbagyizanu" which means “we are Gbagyi people”. [ 25 ]
